title: Wire Transfer Policy
text: The daily wire limit for a personal account is $25,000 when sent through online or mobile banking and $100,000 when sent in branch with two pieces of ID. Business accounts have a daily wire limit of $250,000. Limits reset at midnight Eastern time and apply across all of a customer's personal accounts combined.

title: Wire Transfer Policy
text: The first wire to a new payee over $10,000 is held for 24 hours under hold code WH-24. A hold may be released early only by a Fraud Operations supervisor, and a supervisor must also approve release when the wire's risk score is 70 or above. Holds are recorded on the wire and the customer is told the release time.

title: Retail Operations Handbook
text: Domestic wires received by 4:00 pm Eastern are sent the same business day; international wires by 2:00 pm Eastern. The Halifax branches accept wires until 3:30 pm Atlantic for same-day processing. Wires after cut-off go the next business day.

title: Card Fee Schedule
text: An annual card fee is refunded in full when the card is closed within 60 days of the fee posting. After 60 days no refund is given. The refund posts to the account within 5 business days of closure.

title: Card Dispute Procedure
text: For a disputed card transaction over $50, a provisional credit must be posted within 10 business days of the dispute being opened while the investigation continues. The investigation must close within 45 days. Disputes need the merchant receipt or statement extract before they go to the network.

title: AML and KYC Standard
text: Customer due diligence records are kept for 5 years after the account is closed or the last transaction, whichever is later. A KYC refresh is due every 3 years for personal customers and every year for high-risk customers.
